title: Eclipse 2026
description:
Meet at the Wyche Bus Stop (not sure why Strava doesn't give this option!) 

Partial eclipse will be at its maximum (and near total) at 19:12 
(The next total solar eclipse in the UK will be 23/09/2090.)

Plan to set off from the Wyche at 18:30 just after the eclipse begins. Walk - run strategy. 

Prior to that will run a middle hill loop setting off promptly at 17:15 - usual steady run walking hills as required. 

Feel free to join at either point.

Run ends on arrival at Worcestershire Beacon so please be prepared to make own way back down as and when you wish. 

Hopefully it will be a clear evening so we get maximum effect from the eclipse. 

H&S - runners to make own preparations for safe viewing. 

https://www.timeanddate.com/eclipse/in/uk

Any questions (not scientific please) 
LiRF: Julie Slack [Phone Number Redacted]
